END-TO-END VERIFIED AT p = 50000. The blocker is fully cleared. Recommend closing.

Same reproduction as the original report - volume 50x40x25 at 3mm, obs=96, q=4, two runs, searchlights r=6.1mm, identity metric:

  BEFORE                                        AFTER
  lm_relation_fit          1.7s  ok             5.4s  ok
  compile_frame            1.2s  ok             4.8s  ok    nnz 1557872, support 31.2
  plan_geometry           55.9s  FAILED  ->     3.8s  ok    packed_width 10, 50000 measurements,
                          18.6 GiB alloc                    dense payload 10.7 MB
  evaluate_geometry         not reached        59.3s  ok
  geometry (materialize)    not reached        93.0s  ok

plan_geometry went from a hard allocation failure at 55.9s to a 3.8s success. The full pipeline completes in about 166 seconds.

THIS CORRECTS MY OWN WALL-TIME EXTRAPOLATION. I reported ~p^1.8 scaling and projected roughly 19 minutes at 50k for q=4. That measurement was taken on the pre-fix code, where the dense coercion was inflating every stage it touched, so the exponent was contaminated by the defect itself. The real figure is about 2.8 minutes end to end at 50k - comfortably inside the Epic 8 30-minute gate, with full geometry materialization also succeeding at 93s. My earlier number should be disregarded.

Combined with the projected memory table on Epic 8, the picture for the gate is now: at 50k nodes, q=4, identity metric, roughly 166s wall and a 10.7 MB dense payload. The remaining unknowns for Epic 8 are realistic q and the dense local-metric path, not this blocker.

Note the two upstream stages got slower (1.7 -> 5.4s and 1.2 -> 4.8s). That is probably unrelated concurrent Epic 7 work rather than the fix, since neither touches the frame signature, but it is worth a glance if Epic 8 measures precisely.
